beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Simple mode now pre-grades Schoology work without OCR or AI: activity logs are scored from their logged hours, gradebook printouts are summarized, and everything else gets a neutral comment with the grade left for you.
• Student rosters refresh automatically every day instead of every week, so a student you move between classes shows up in the right place.

Fixes:
• Fixed course boxes showing "Missing" for students who had been removed from a Schoology section. Dropped enrollments are retired on sync and their empty placeholders no longer count.
• Fixed work due later today, or later in the current learning period, being marked Missing before its deadline.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
